notes.title: Scarecrow DEMO 2025 Release!
notes.content:
Hi all! We are pleased to inform you that a new version of the Scarecrow DEMO has been released today!
The demo version can be downloaded for free on Steam. 

Play, enjoy and share your opinion about the demo in the VK group! 
https://vk.com/topic-215651948_53251593
(or you can leave a review in Community Hub on Steam)

Have a nice game!

- ChillouT Studio

notes.title: New Scarecrow DEMO Announcement!
notes.content:
Hi! ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43683767/021df3ba70aa26134c31af0b33ec150d7ccae5b4.png[/img]

We have good news - a new demo version of Scarecrow is coming out on January 31. A year and a half has passed since the release of the first demo, and we've done a lot of work. In just 2 days, you will be able to experience for yourself what Scarecrow has become over these many months!

Thank you for staying with us.

- ChillouT Studio
